prose: Basis: the project's blog post excerpt in the cache - only part of the page came through. This Show HN releases a fine-tune of Qwen3-4B with the characteristic AI writing tics trained out of it. The post evaluates the released model against the original on 40 held-out prompts spanning ten topics in four genres, with no system prompt, showing one sampled answer per prompt from each model. A 'slop detector' counts the tics, and the underlined passages in the examples are what it flags. The cache did not include the training recipe or download details.
